nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code skill definition instructing the agent to fetch Vercel's Web Interface Guidelines and review UI code files against them for accessibility, UX, and best-practice compliance.

nodes.name: .gitattributes
nodes.summary: Git attributes configuration enforcing LF line endings for source/text files, CRLF for Windows scripts, and marking image/font formats as binary.

nodes.name: .hintrc
nodes.summary: Webhint linter configuration extending the 'development' ruleset while disabling specific accessibility form-label and select-name checks.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Ignore-pattern file for the Understand-Anything analysis tool, mirroring common .gitignore entries (logs, env files, databases, uploads) that should be excluded from codebase scanning.

nodes.name: visa-requirements.json
nodes.summary: Static reference dataset of visa requirements for passport-country/destination-country pairs, including visa type, max stay duration, and source citations, used to power a visa-requirement lookup feature.

nodes.name: jest.config.js
nodes.summary: Jest test-runner configuration for the backend, using ts-jest with a Node environment, path alias mapping, coverage thresholds (50%), and a shared test setup file.

nodes.name: prisma.config.ts
nodes.summary: Prisma CLI configuration that defines the datasource connection using the DATABASE_URL environment variable.

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: Migration that adds a timezone column (default 'UTC') to the users table to support per-user timezone preferences.

nodes.name: lodging
nodes.summary: Migration that renames lodging columns to clearer names (check_in_date, check_out_date, confirmation_number), drops the rating column, and adds type and address columns.

nodes.name: trip_tags
nodes.summary: Migration that adds a text_color column to the trip_tags table to support custom tag text coloring.

nodes.name: journal_activities
nodes.summary: Migration creating junction tables journal_activities, journal_lodgings, and journal_transportations that link journal entries to activities, lodgings, and transportation records, each with a unique constraint index.

nodes.name: checklists
nodes.summary: Migration creating the checklists and checklist_items tables to support user-defined trip checklists with default templates, checked state, and sort ordering.

nodes.name: travel_companions
nodes.summary: Migration that adds an avatar_url column to the travel_companions table for storing companion profile pictures.

nodes.name: travel_companions
nodes.summary: Migration that adds an is_myself boolean flag to the travel_companions table to identify the companion record representing the trip owner.

nodes.name: route_cache
nodes.summary: Migration creating the route_cache table to cache computed route distances and durations between coordinate pairs by travel profile, with a lookup index on the coordinate/profile columns.

nodes.name: photo_albums
nodes.summary: Migration that adds a cover_photo_id column to photo_albums with a foreign key referencing photos, enabling album cover images.

nodes.name: photos
nodes.summary: Migration that drops the location_id column from the photos table, decoupling photo location data from the previous relation.

nodes.name: locations
nodes.summary: Migration that adds PostGIS geography(Point,4326) coordinate columns to the locations and photos tables with GIST spatial indexes for efficient geospatial queries.

nodes.name: activities
nodes.summary: Migration that adds a manual_order column to the activities table with a composite index on trip_id and manual_order to support user-defined activity ordering.

nodes.name: locations
nodes.summary: Migration that adds a self-referencing parent_id column and foreign key to the locations table, enabling parent/child location hierarchies.

nodes.name: users
nodes.summary: Migration that adds aviationstack_api_key and openrouteservice_api_key columns to the users table for storing per-user third-party API credentials.

nodes.name: route_cache
nodes.summary: Migration that adds a route_geometry JSONB column to route_cache for storing detailed route geometry alongside cached distance/duration data.

nodes.name: entity_links
nodes.summary: Migration creating the entity_links table, a generic polymorphic linking table connecting arbitrary trip entities (source/target type and id) with relationship metadata, superseding earlier per-entity journal junction tables.

nodes.name: journal_photos
nodes.summary: Migration that drops the legacy journal_photos, journal_locations, journal_activities, journal_lodgings, and journal_transportations junction tables, now superseded by the unified entity_links system.

nodes.name: trip_invitations
nodes.summary: Migration creating the trip_invitations table to track email invitations sent to trip collaborators, including permission level, token, status, and expiration, with supporting lookup indexes.
